quality_control_status: All 1,717,290,624 read pairs from 50 single-oyster libraries quantified with Salmon 2.3.4 against GCF_963853765.1/RS_2024_06 (51 runs from NCBI .sra archives; 13Ebis left out as a resequencing of oyster 13E); mapping rates 71.27-83.67% (median 78.58%), not different between bands (control 78.8% versus acidified 78.0%, Welch t = 1.29). The primary model is ~ gametogenesis + condition (25 v 25): 4,725 of 28,811 tested genes reach nominal FDR < 0.05 under an oyster-level model that does not account for tank clustering; this significance is exploratory (2,735 acidified-higher, 1,990 acidified-lower). The unadjusted ~ condition model gives 6,739; 4,058 genes are significant in both and 97.2% of unadjusted significant genes keep their direction (log2FC r = 0.71). Top genes include a monocarboxylate transporter and Kunitz protease inhibitors up and the shell-matrix protein N66, parathyroid-hormone receptors and arginine kinase down.

quality_control_status: Salmon 2.3.4 (--noLengthCorrection, sequence-bias correction) against GCF_963853765.1/RS_2024_06 on all 72 QuantSeq libraries; mapping rates are low for 3' tag-seq against the annotated transcriptome (18.7-46.4%, median 34.3%, among the 63 analysed libraries) but similar across arms (control 31.7%, 30 C 33.5%). Nine libraries were left out because their median VST correlation with the other libraries fell below the median minus three robust SDs (0.834): N56, X44, X42, T62, R53, N54 and M43, which the authors also excluded, and R62 and N57; the authors' eighth exclusion, D54, passes and is kept.
